prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Emberveil Pixel, a subdued post-apocalyptic pixel-art RPG. Crisp hand-dithered pixel clusters, readable dark outlines, limited dusty olive, brown, charcoal and grey palette, restrained amber edge light. No photorealism, glossy rendering, text, labels, borders, grid lines, watermark, drop shadows, floor or checkerboard. Exactly THREE full-body poses in ONE horizontal row, evenly spaced in three isolated columns: left IDLE, center ATTACKING LEFT, right HURT recoiling. Same character design, scale and proportions in every pose. All face LEFT. Every silhouette fully contained in its column with at least 20% transparent outer margin and wide transparent gaps; no overlap. Landscape canvas. Genuine transparent RGBA background. All three feet at the same baseline. Subject: an emaciated pale adult man, crouched tense shoulders visibly shivering, ragged dusty grey cloth shirt and torn brown trousers, bare thin forearms, worn feet. No hood, armour, weapon or backpack. Attack is an unexpected unarmed leftward punch; hurt has raised defensive forearm. Distinct from the cloak-wearing player.

Use case: stylized-concept. 16:9 background for a side-view dark post-apocalyptic pixel-art RPG. INTERIOR of a tiny moss-covered swamp timber cabin. Crisp hand-dithered pixel clusters, muted charcoal, damp olive, dusty wood brown, faint amber highlights. Weathered plank walls with moss creeping through cracks, shadowed doorway at left, small high window at right showing damp green reeds, woven reed mat and humble old shelf, minimal old pots in back. Room is poor, quiet and abandoned-looking. FLOOR plane runs horizontally, clear character foot baseline at 79.5% down the picture. Leave open uncluttered space around x25% for the traveler and x73% for a seated elder. No people, animals, humanoid silhouettes, weapons, text, UI, dramatic beams or magic. Opaque landscape 16:9 composition, sharp pixel clusters, no blur or vignette.
